layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Stegosaurid dorsal plate morphology
features: A series of large, kite-shaped clay plates standing vertically
The plates are arranged in a staggered, alternating double row along a curved clay back
Each plate has a rough, tactile clay surface with subtle grooves suggesting blood vessels
Colors range from a warm sandy yellow to a dusty orange, contrasting with the dark green clay of the body
The edges of the plates are slightly thinned and translucent-looking, like rolled clay
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic side-on macro shot of the dorsal plates. The lighting emphasizes the 'staggered' arrangement and the leaf-like shape of the plates. This serves as a 'Plates' morphology icon. No text.
